summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block) with the constructor (dist_matrix, reduction), forward, the four helpers, and the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias. Nothing was run, per instructions, so the tests are unverified. Hand-checking the batch-coupling example gives TP 0.8, D 2.4, and loss about 0.333, matching the spec. No commits were made.
